## Description

CATIA writes per-edge tolerance values (via `geometric_representation_context_and_global_uncertainty_assigned_context` plus per-edge precisions encoded in the entity attributes) that are 2-3 orders of magnitude larger than the file's default tolerance. Receivers reading only the global tolerance find gaps between adjacent faces and treat the body as an open shell.

## Reproducer recipe

CATIA-emitted STEP with file tolerance 0.0001 mm but specific edges using 0.005 mm tolerance metadata.

## Expected kernel behavior

heal — respect per-edge tolerance metadata; do not collapse to a single document tolerance. Tag every edge/vertex with its own tolerance budget.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `heal`
